title_seed: 一個成功案例不能代表系統
central_problem: 一個 Case A 通過 citation/layout/cross-format，為什麼 Case B 仍然必須 blocked？
reader_takeaway: publication acceptance 是 case- and run-scoped，不是產品全域宣告。

known_at_the_time.fact: publication layout/citation QA 對 Case A 通過 citation、content integrity、cross-format 與 visual gates。
Case B supported content 不足，因此沒有 DOCX/PDF export。

implemented_at_the_time.fact: reader citation、canonical document、DOCX/PDF parity 與 rendered visual QA 被分開驗證。

not_yet_available.fact: Case A publication pass 不證明 unseen-topic generalization 或 broad live full-text coverage。

observed_failures.symptom: Case B remained below supported-content threshold despite other integrity checks
observed_failures.root_cause_if_known: supported evidence was insufficient for the requested report
observed_failures.what_was_known_then: export must remain blocked and no filler/fabricated evidence is allowed
observed_failures.later_resolution: publication pipeline preserved case separation and later generalization kept new cases blocked

tests_and_metrics.test_or_metric: Publication QA Case A resolved 20/20 citations; the same report also records an independently blocked Case B.

engineering_decisions.decision: 只讓通過所有 content/citation/layout gates 的 case export；不同 case 不互相借用成功。

architecture_state.state: canonical report → reader citations/layout → DOCX/PDF → rendered visual QA

safe_numbers.meaning: publication QA Case A metric; case-scoped

safe_public_facts.fact: 一個可發布案例證明一條路可行，不證明每個輸入都能走完同一條路。

retrospective_notes.note: 下一步必須換題目測試，而不是把 Case A 的 evidence 偷渡給新題。

publication_risks: 不要把 Case A READY 改寫成 all-cases READY。
不要公開內部 case IDs 或 raw artifacts。
